notes: Best-covered task of the five: self-signed-certificate generation is a recurring motif in TMax (207 instructions mention self-signed) and RTS has a genuinely excellent match in rts_task_7c2c9533c50d05a84a2b2980 (openssl self-signed cert with a required CN, key at mode 600) that the retrievers ranked nowhere. final_top10 is 4 TMax, 4 RTS, 1 TW; that is the honest ordering. Note that RTS also carries the best matches for the verification.txt half (Subject/Issuer/SHA-256-fingerprint reports) while TMax carries the best matches for the generation half - a merge should keep both families rather than deduplicating to one. SWE-Smith is the weak corpus: only 5 instructions mention pyOpenSSL and exactly 1 mentions file permissions, so its list leans on paramiko crypto-primitive bugs and date-formatting bugs and caps at overall 3. SWE-Rebench is saved by the pyca/cryptography entries, which are the exact library check_cert.py would import.
